answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the glacier accrues. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the oasis of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. The crystal ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal 1va57.
